scamshield.name: ScamShield: Multilingual Smishing & Social Engineering Corpus

label_definitions.head1_social_engineering: Multi-label psychological cues (urgency, fear, financial_pressure, authority_impersonation, reward_bait)
label_definitions.head2_scam_intent: Fine-grained intent category (e.g., Fake KYC, UPI Fraud, Lottery / Prize, Courier Scam, Legitimate / Benign)

scamshield.known_limitations: Severe language imbalance (~89% English, ~7.4% Hindi, ~3.5% Hinglish); 0 Tamil or Bengali samples; 'fake_investment' tactic has 0 verified ground-truth annotations; contains 978 near-duplicate template groups.

permitted_commercial_usage.terms: Permitted under MIT License with copyright and permission notice preservation.

sms_phishing.name: SMS Phishing Dataset for Machine Learning and Pattern Recognition

label_definitions.ham: Legitimate personal or informational SMS (4,844 raw rows)
label_definitions.Smishing / smishing: SMS phishing / credential or financial lure (638 raw rows)

sms_phishing.known_limitations: 5,756 of 5,971 rows (96.4%) overlap with ScamShield and must be deduplicated (leaving 215 novel rows); inconsistent label casing ('Spam'/'spam', 'Smishing'/'smishing'); English-only.

permitted_commercial_usage.terms: Permitted under CC BY 4.0 with mandatory author attribution and indication of changes.

legitphish.name: LegitPhish URL Dataset

label_definitions.empty: 1 malformed row with missing ClassLabel (dropped during validation)

legitphish.known_limitations: 100,872 clean URLs span only 63,962 unique domains (requires domain-grouped splitting to prevent leakage); class imbalance (62.94% phishing); lexical features only without live HTTP/DNS verification; near-zero positive samples for has_ip_address.

permitted_commercial_usage.terms: Permitted under CC BY 4.0 with mandatory author attribution.

uci_sms_spam.name: UCI SMS Spam Collection
uci_sms_spam.known_limitations: Historical 2011 UK/Singapore SMS corpus (predates modern UPI/KYC/WhatsApp scams); class imbalance (13.4% spam); partial overlap with downstream Mendeley/ScamShield corpora requires deduplication.

permitted_commercial_usage.terms: Permitted under CC BY 4.0 with attribution to Almeida & Hidalgo.

phishtank_feed.name: PhishTank Verified Online Phishing URL Feed
phishtank_feed.collection_date: Rolling live feed (snapshot timestamped at ingestion)

label_definitions.verified=yes, online=yes: Community-verified active phishing URL at time of snapshot

phishtank_feed.record_count: Dynamic rolling feed (~10,000-50,000 active verified URLs per snapshot)
phishtank_feed.known_limitations: Phishing-only positive class (requires paired legitimate URLs); rate-limited without registered PHISHTANK_APP_KEY and descriptive User-Agent; provided AS-IS without accuracy/uptime warranty; short-lived URLs cause temporal drift.

permitted_commercial_usage.terms: PhishTank Terms of Use explicitly permit commercial use of Data feeds free of charge; requires descriptive User-Agent (e.g. phishtank/<username>) and respect for HTTP 509 rate limits.

urlhaus_community.name: abuse.ch URLhaus Malicious URL Feed

license.name: abuse.ch Community Fair-Use / Spamhaus Terms of Service

urlhaus_community.collection_date: Rolling live feed (last 30 days of malware distribution URLs)
urlhaus_community.known_limitations: Malware-distribution URLs rather than credential-phishing pages; community feed is restricted to research/non-commercial/fair-use.

permitted_commercial_usage.terms: BLOCKED FOR COMMERCIAL TRAINING/PRODUCT USE: Free URLhaus community feeds are for non-commercial, academic research, or internal non-profit defense under fair-use terms. Commercial/for-profit product integration requires a paid abuse.ch/Spamhaus commercial API agreement.

cisa_kev.name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog

source.provider: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
authors: U.S. Department of Homeland Security / CISA

cisa_kev.collection_date: Rolling government catalog (snapshot timestamped at ingestion)

label_definitions.cveID: Authoritative CVE identifier with confirmed active exploitation

cisa_kev.known_limitations: Vulnerability/CVE intelligence rather than SMS/URL phishing text; useful for threat-intel enrichment and advisory correlation, not direct SMS classification; no CISA/DHS endorsement implied.

permitted_commercial_usage.terms: Public Domain (CC0 1.0); commercial use permitted without restriction, without implying CISA/DHS endorsement.
